# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 1: Fourth Odyssey Act I — The Western Crossing (oe_ely_). Generated by gen_elysia_exodus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_fourth_odyssey = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	can_start = {
		NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
	}
	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
			AND = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_ely_eligible_tag = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Landfall on the Chesapeake (Success -> activates Act II Slot 73)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_fourth_odyssey_landfall"
		desc = "oe_sit_fourth_odyssey_landfall_desc"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		}
		immediate = {
			# Atomic foundation & Old World detachment completed cleanly by oe_ely_complete_landfall.
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Voyage Abandoned or Timed Out (Safe Cleanup)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_fourth_odyssey_aborted"
		desc = "oe_sit_fourth_odyssey_aborted_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = oe_ely_voyage_months
					global_var:oe_ely_voyage_months >= 72
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
				}
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_aborted value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_months value = 0 }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_months add = 1 }
	}
	on_ended = { }

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_ely_map_voyager_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					area = area:virginia_area
					area = area:maryland_area
					area = area:bermuda_area
					area = area:azores_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_ely_map_chesapeake_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TUR
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { tag = TUR }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_ely_map_ottoman_tt
		}
	}

	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
			}
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					area = area:virginia_area
					area = area:maryland_area
					area = area:bermuda_area
					area = area:azores_area
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TUR
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { tag = TUR }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
}
